svg.title: D2 v2 assembled
svg.text: D2 v2 FORM AND ITS VOID, COMPACT - assembled
105 x 118 card on the table. Lift S, lift P, hook the lip over the crown of S. No glue.
P flanged strut, hook lip on S
SIDE SECTION 2:1 - closed triangle base / S / P
S 32 at 75 deg ; P 44.3 at 44.3 deg ; red = flange (edge-on)
